content.summary: The question and admission threshold are properly framed around actual-family Profile A/B exclusions and a conditional global implication. The frozen receipts support admission to substantive review, while their cached-dependency limitations prevent a stronger source-rebuild conclusion at this phase. The manuscript clearly distinguishes local formal results, an ordinary corollary using external I27, and unproved exploratory cap45 diagnostics.

findings.statement: Admission receipts print the literal I27-to-G80 proposition and a two-star theorem with actual family hypotheses, so the admitted target is more than an assembled list of undischarged A/B premises. I27 remains an antecedent rather than an audited project axiom.
findings.disposition: Admission is methodologically justified for review; this is not yet a full proof or source-closure audit.

findings.statement: Section 6 expressly withholds universal45 and SAT-UNSAT claims and retains failed Lean witness attempts; neither diagnostic is a premise of the proposed 80 proof.
findings.disposition: Preserve these boundaries in all subsequent revisions and assess their actual finite coverage in the reproducibility phase.

findings.statement: The frozen evidence still describes cached dependencies and a pending source-closure rebuild. Its assurance presently supports the reported elaboration/axiom audit, not a complete source rebuild or independent replay.
findings.disposition: The manuscript already makes this distinction. Later rounds should assess any newly supplied source-closure evidence at its actual coverage.

checks.scope: Review-admission criterion against literal theorem outputs
checks.method: Read the frozen admission record and three audit receipts; matched their file SHA256 values to the snapshot and compared printed antecedents/conclusions to Theorems 1–3.
checks.observation: All four hashes match. Profile A is printed under IntersectingRankFourUpper 27, Profile B and the terminal implication are passing audit roots, and the printed two-star theorem is quantified over arbitrary finite families and Type u_1 with degree20/noncooccurrence hypotheses. The conditional/global and unconditional/structural scopes are consistent.

checks.scope: Definitions, contribution scope, and diagnostic-to-theorem separation
checks.method: Read frozen sections 1–2 and 5–7 and trace which statements are designated inherited, newly proved, externally supplied, or exploratory.
checks.observation: Distinct sets, three petals, empty cores, fixed rank, and finite arbitrary support are explicit. I27 is external for the ordinary corollary and a quantified formal antecedent; the 45 diagnostic and UNKNOWN SAT attempt are not used as proof premises. Source closure is not assumed completed.
